23. The acceleration due to the gravity of the Earth is 9.8 m/ s². If mass of the Jupiter is 319times the Earth and its radius is
11 times the radius of the Earth, calculate the acceleration of gravity of Jupiter, What is the weight of an object of mass 100
kg on Jupiter? (Ans: 25.84 m/ s², 2584 N)
Ans: Given Acceleration due to gravity (𝑔𝑒) = 9.8 m/ s²
We know that, acceleration due to gravity (𝑔𝑗) = 𝑅𝑗2 𝐺𝑀𝑗 = 11𝑅𝑒2 𝐺319 𝑀𝑒 = (11𝑅𝑒)2 𝐺319 𝑀𝑒 = 121 𝑅𝑒2 319 𝐺 𝑀𝑒 = 319 121 𝑔𝑒 = 319 121 * 9.8 = 25.83 m/ s²
Weight of object on Jupiter W= m𝑔𝑗 = 100 * 25.83 = 2584 N
Acceleration due to gravity on Jupiter is 25.83 m/ s² and Weight of 100 kg object on Jupiter is 2584 N.
